periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the periocular patches are oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle, converging toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal visual ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward elongation resulting in a teardrop-shaped taper where the lowest point is significantly distal to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior margin of the transverse interscapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark transverse band occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible vertical torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ear regions are set wide apart with a gap roughly equivalent to the width of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and smoothly rounded curvature at the superior boundaries of the pinnae.
